reels.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses the core challenge of training models on lower precision (FP4), which is vital for consumer hardware efficiency. The visual potential of 'rollout generation' as a high-speed particle stream being quantized into discrete blocks is perfect for a 3b1b-style aesthetic.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How can we teach AI to think faster by forgetting the tiny details?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Downscaling a high-resolution 4K photo into a mosaic of bold, primary-colored tiles without losing the shape of the image.
